role: Nearest-attackable-target restricted to untamed animals: an untamed wolf or ocelot uses it to hunt (the ocelot targets chickens); once tamed the task stops firing.
scope_reason: Only EntityWolf and EntityOcelot register this task (grep over oracle/src), and world.conf forces wolves = off and ocelots = off, so it is never constructed, in the oracle too (SPEC 'Unsupported features are world switches').
